The '''Alderbathe system''' was a part of the [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Alderbathe Monastery]].<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alderbathe [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-6.<ref name="TEA" />
